snippet.title: Grand Theft Auto: Stars And Stripes [Launch Trailer]
snippet.description:
After several months of work, ACH Team is ready to release their latest project "Stars & Stripes".
The public's opinion was taken into account and numerous changes were made with respect to the "Public Beta" version, and we are proud to finally give the release date. October 26th.

S&S (Story Mode): It is about a young man (Ethan Fielder) who after losing his brother, enters the dangerous criminal world to find him and discover the truth behind a dangerous conspiracy.
Traveling through the country of the USA (GTA Universe) overcoming challenges that will test him both physically and mentally.

Stay tuned to our dicord server for more information
Discord: https://discord.gg/njexEMfE

Music: Beat it (Michael J)

ACH Games 2024.
